posts.text:
Today, I almost got fired by myself. 😂

“Mai tujhe uninstall karne ja rha.” 😭

ChatGPT: “Arey bhai 😭 itni badi saza kyun de rahe ho?”

Me: “Joke 🤣”

And just like that, the AI survived another day. 😂

Honestly, this is what I love about AI tools today - they’re not just tools we use for work anymore.

Sometimes they become:
→ Brainstorming partners  
→ Writing assistants  
→ Problem-solving buddies  
→ And apparently… emotional support systems too. 😂

185 weeks ki dosti ek “Uninstall” se khatam hone wali thi. 😭🤣

Anyway, ChatGPT bach gaya.  
Ab agla kand kya karein? 😎

Today, I randomly searched my name on Google.

Honestly, I wasn’t expecting much.

But seeing Google connect my journey with terms like Founder, Entrepreneur, Tech LinkedIn Creator, AI, Careers, and the Creator Economy felt like a small but meaningful moment. ❤️

Over the years, I’ve simply focused on building.

Building communities.
Building platforms.
Building ideas that I believe can create an impact.

From Coding Bits, JobCrexa, and BrandCrexa to now building RURBOO for Bharat, every project started with a simple idea and a willingness to take the first step.

Sometimes, when you're busy building every day, you don't realise how far you've come.

Then one random Google search gives you a moment to pause, look back, and say:

“Maybe all those small efforts are actually adding up.”

Still a long way to go.
Still a lot to build.
Still learning every single day.

But today, I’m grateful for this little reminder.

The journey is just getting started. 🚀❤️
